act: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (as applicable to Delhi), Schedule I-A

source.ref: Indian Stamp Act, 1899, Sch. I-A Art. 15 (Delhi)
source.quoted_text: Sch I-A Art. 15 (both columns): 'BOND as defined by section 2(5) not being a DEBENTURE (No.27) and not being otherwise provided for by this Act or by the Court Fees Act, 1870' — duty column: '2% and 0.5% on bond issued by the local authority'. Founder ruling (Q2, 2026-07-16): this text is correct and parses as — general bonds → 2% of the amount secured; bonds issued by a local authority → 0.5%. No cap in the article text. Sanity reconciliation: lease under one year = 'same duty as Bond No. 15 on whole amount payable' = 2% of the rent, matching the universally-quoted Delhi 11-month rent-agreement figure.

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: HIGH (founder-ruled parse + independent practitioner corroboration + cross-ref chain reconciles with observed 2% rent-agreement practice).
